package rulefixtures

import (
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"time"
)

// scenario for audit_logging_executed_in_handler_before_service_success: Audit writes that happen before the service has confirmed success.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.
type AuditLogger struct{}
func (a *AuditLogger) Log(action, resource string, id int, ts time.Time) {}

type TransferService struct{}
func (s *TransferService) Transfer(from, to int, amount float64) error { return nil }

func transferHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, logger *AuditLogger, svc *TransferService) {
	fromID := 1001
	toID := 2002
	amount := 150.00

	logger.Log("transfer", "account", fromID, time.Now())

	if err := svc.Transfer(fromID, toID, amount); err != nil {
		http.Error(w, fmt.Sprintf("transfer failed: %v", err), http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}

	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
	fmt.Fprintln(w, "transfer completed")
}
